name: The Wonderful Company LLC
note: American consumer-brand company headquartered in Los Angeles; its own careers pages describe it as 'a privately held $6 billion company' and name Lynda and Stewart Resnick as its co-founders. Its brand list includes FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, Wonderful Pistachios, Wonderful Halos, JUSTIN Vineyards and Teleflora (wonderful.com 'Our Brands'). Root of the chain.
